crossRefs.note: He lived in the tombs. Nobody could bind him any more, not even with chains,
because he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been torn apart by him, and the fetters…
They came to Jesus, and saw him who had been possessed by demons sitting, clothed, and in his right mind, even him who…
For Jesus was commanding the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For the unclean spirit had often seized the man. He…
People went out to see what had happened. They came to Jesus and found the man from whom the demons had gone out…

translations.web: The man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them, overpowered them, and prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.
translations.bsb: Then the man with the evil spirit jumped on them and overpowered them all. The attack was so violent that they ran out of the house naked and wounded.
translations.kjv: And the man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them, and overcame them, and prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.
translations.asv: And the man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them, and mastered both of them, and prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.
